supportDefinition: Existing IK declared stance AND actual skinned sole vertex within 1mm of ground
comparison: Continuous existing D3-C v2 IK versus sample-and-hold of identical baked poses with continuous root travel at 4m/s. Same source vertex IDs, no targets used as measurements.
limits: Pose sampling errors at straight 1x speed only.
Turning changes planted foot world orientation and adds further error; not quantified as IK-correct turning.
Speed changes use distance-linked cadence with a fixed baked stride, not the original runtime variable-stride solver.
